Two Pipeline-A types are unrouted and CI stays red, but the fix row for one of them was CANCELLED as satisfied. Root cause is the VERIFICATION METHOD, not a missing table row.

(1) sprint_registry_dangling_ids -- NAMING MISMATCH. Emitter scripts/orch-validate.mjs (stage1h) emits the literal type "sprint_registry_dangling_ids". The routing table docs/agents/po/flow/triage-signals.md contains "sprint_registry_unresolved_journal_ids" -- grep for the EMITTED string returns 0 hits. PO cancelled FIX-SIGNAL-TYPE-ROUTING-GAP-sprint-registry-unresolved-journal-ids (archive, CANCELLED, 2026-08-23T14:40Z) with note "verified already satisfied, not abandoned ... confirmed by grep on the live doc". The grep was run against the name PO chose for the row, not the literal the emitter produces. Re-adding a row will fail again unless it uses the emitter's exact string.

(2) recurring-bug -- 0 routing hits. Source is docs/agents/dev-team/flow/main.md HEAD.lock-recurrence example, which templates type: "recurring-bug". Any reader following the template emits an unrouted type. Self-inflicted by this router on the 15:37Z tick and re-confirmed present this tick.

CORROBORATION DEFECT: PO's cancellation note also cites guard-signal-type-coverage.sh reporting auto-push-abort as "the sole remaining unrouted type". That reading was taken immediately after PO's own Step 0-SIG inbox CLEAR. The guard derives its Pipeline-A set from pending_triage_inbox[], so a just-cleared inbox yields a near-green guard regardless of table state. Green-because-input-was-deleted, already documented as the inverse failure mode.

ASK: (a) add routing rows keyed on the EXACT emitted literals -- sprint_registry_dangling_ids and recurring-bug -- verified by grepping the emitter source, not the row title; (b) fix the main.md template to use a routed type; (c) when verifying any signal-type routing fix, grep the emitter for the literal and never use the guard's exit code in either direction.

MEASURED 2026-08-23T16:2xZ, dev-team 16:07Z tick. Live inbox depth 18: bug-escalation 5, bctc_signal 4, recurring-bug 2, cowork-fire 2, context_bloat_breach 2, sprint_registry_dangling_ids 1, data-coverage-gap 1, ci_red 1. cowork-fire is now ROUTED (earlier gap did land).
